pages.title: Magnetic Confinement Casing
pages.text: A casing that holds plasma away from its own walls with superconducting magnetic fields, tuned by dilithium. It works on the same principle as a tokamak. It hums, and the hum gets louder when plasma is near.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Plasma at stellar temperatures melts anything it touches. I wound superconducting coil around spacetime casing and tuned it with dilithium so the field keeps the plasma floating in the middle and away from the walls.

Made in a crafting grid.$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Horizon Simulation.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Matter-Antimatter Annihilation Reactor, Mirror Matter Foundry, Neutron Star Forge, Nucleosynthesis Chamber, Nuclide Forge, Plasma Crucible Casing, Plasma Injection Nozzle, Stellar Containment Plate and more.
